mints.why_zero: Hospitality is the store's own furniture walked from the opposite seat (pod-0/POD-1 were derived on cafés, counters, orders and bills from the customer's chair; role assignment is a walk annotation, so the seat-flip costs nothing). Its duty strand stops at REFUSING the guest — the drink, the door, the capacity — which N401 [ireland] carries whole, and never crosses into the consent-overridden act on the other party's property that N501 [trades] adds. Four sectors' mints all concentrate where duty crosses from refusal into compelled act; hospitality's duty never crosses that line, so it needs nothing new.

port_verdict.headline: Hospitality costs the trunk zero new ids — the four-sector cost curve is 10 → 2 → 1 → 0, and the zero is structural: the sector is the store's home furniture walked from the opposite seat, and its duty never crosses from refusal into compelled act.
port_verdict.dependency: The zero is computed against store + health Family A/B + Ireland's pair (nothing leans on trades' 5xx ids). If Family A were rejected upstream, ~6 shapes plus F101/F103/O101 would re-mint here; if Ireland's pair were rejected, N401/N402 would re-mint almost verbatim. Hospitality is the second sector to independently re-attest Ireland's pair and the third to re-attest Family A's core — the standing argument for accepting both upstream.
